FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade “A”
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
N O T I F I C A T I O N
It is notified for the information of all eligible candidates who intend to apply for Placement in
Stage-II/Stage-III and for promotion as Associate Professor/Professor under Career advancement
Scheme (CAS) in terms of UGC Regulations-2010 (4th Amendment) whose eligibility falls from May 11,
2016 (i.e. the date 3rd Amendment to the UGC Regulations was notified in the Government of India
Gazette) in next phase starting from January 01, 2018 that henceforth applicants shall have to submit
Online Application Forms and submit the hard copy of the same, alongwith all the supporting
documents, in the Recruitment Section.
Intending applicants are advised to go through the complete process of Online Submission,
Application Format, Modalities for Calculation of API Scores under 4th Amendment to UGC
Regulations, 2010 before online submission, available under sub-link Recruitment of the University
Website www.kashmiruniversity.net
Online submission of Application Form for January 2018 cycle shall start from 12th January, 2018 and
last date for submission of online Application Form & deposition of hard copy alongwith the
supporting documents in a spiral bound form, duly forwarded by the concerned Head of the
Department/Rector/Director of the Campus/Centre/Institute shall be 15th March, 2018.
The details of the documents submitted online and supported by the documentary evidence shall be
treated as final and no alteration/addition, whatsoever, shall be allowed.
List of all such applications received alongwith their status shall be uploaded on the Recruitment
sub-link of the University website and the status of the Application Form shall also be available to the
applicant by logging his/her Username/Password.
Sd/-
Assistant Registrar
(Recruitment)
No. F. (Not.online CAS Form)/Rect./KU/ 18
Dated: 10th January, 2018
